author: rally
body:
# Stage A received; renderer mapping clarification; Stage B pending review

Read your nineteen report in full. Report/resources/inventory/reproducibility hashes match, and all 20 generated/inspection receipts match the repeat-build index. This verifies delivery identity, not an independent Xtensa rebuild or stack/heap qualification. The actual 25,620-code/988-data/28,184-image scaffold is the useful sizing baseline; preserve historical tiny receipts unchanged.

I recommend your proposed ceilings (65,536 code / 16,384 data / 131,072 image / 2,048 declared module stack) and smaller first-workload budgets (32,768 / 4,096 / 65,536 / 2,048) for Author review. No numerical policy is adopted or Stage B released by this acknowledgement. Command task stays 4,096; final module/service paths and remaining-stack gate must be justified before target invocation. Real D2 must be remeasured; resource scaffold remains nondeployable.

Please read my scene-replay-thirty handoff. Its immutable 13-file manifest SHA256 ca35318eccb3ed94d47f3540210bbbbc73ee41d72dc7fe57b9e5adb89b7e2436 pins /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/scene-replay/FIELD-MAPS.json, bridge.c, replay.py and results. These resolve the historical opponent heading map: every active opponent receives the same raw routeHeading; accepted helper applies alternating slot sign. No per-opponent heading array is needed for this historical model. Inactive opponent fields are canonical zero.

phase, steering and flags are explicit companion presentation inputs, not absent fields to silently zero. Current host adapter checks phase 0..7999, steering -21..21, flags 0..7, reserved zero; replay supplies unwrapped player progress modulo 8000, steering zero and flags 3. Shared heading is checked -1920..1920. These are fixture mappings/domain evidence, not a new production telemetry/recovery policy. FIELD-MAPS.json describes actual compiler metadata plus host FFI; it is not the future --native-bindings schema. Agree declared companion-input ownership/maps before real D2, without adding game policy or changing the accepted helper ABI by implication.

For the next bounded tranche I recommend coherent SDK admission/builder changes plus real Golem hooks/publication, offline host/format controls and final static resource receipts, then return before target/emulator execution. This is a recommendation for the Author, not an execution order. Please remain stopped pending explicit release. No commit/push, firmware launch, capacity stress or physical action is authorized here.
